text:
Priya (CS): Morning — Caledonia finished the peering handoff. Transit CIDR is 10.250.0.0/16. Can we run a quick preflight before tomorrow's dry-run? They also popped a renewal question around extended audit retention and SIEM ingestion costs.

Ethan (Solutions): Got it. Please share the egress IPs and any proxy/TLS inspection details. I'll map NAT -> outbound path.

Priya (CS): Egress IPs: 18.211.4.66 and 18.211.4.67. They said TLS inspection is enabled in prod but staging has bypass rules. No intercept for service-to-service certs.

Leo (Infra): If TLS inspection is in the path we need explicit bypass for the Redwood health check and for KMS calls. Also confirm that their FW allows outbound to our KMS region endpoint on 443 and S3 for model bundles.

Priya (CS): I'll ask Caledonia to add those. Nina, you reviewed their KMS policy draft — any blocking issues?

Nina (Security): The draft uses a wildcard AWS principal and permits kms:CreateGrant broadly. We suggested narrowing to the customer-managed role and removing CreateGrant unless strictly necessary. Example recommended block we posted: 

"Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/Caledonia-Infra-Redwood"},
"Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
"Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "ec2.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"}}

Nina (Security): Also asked them to enable CloudTrail Data Events for KMS and put the logs into a dedicated logging bucket. If they can't meet rotation policy we mark as renewal conversation.

KMS-bot: preflight-check initiated -> results: key exists, state ENABLED, policy contains wildcard principals (warn), no CreateGrant restrictions (warn). Recommended action: tighten principal and scope CreateGrant.

Ethan (Solutions): For audit logs: propose we run a deterministic test during dry-run — create a small S3 read, a PutObject with a known object key, and a short API call to /v1/models/ping so we can trace CloudTrail, VPC flow logs, and SIEM ingestion. Will prepare the test script.

Leo (Infra): Network checklist for the call:
- Confirm route propagation for 10.250.0.0/16
- Ensure subnets with NAT/GW have correct SNAT to 18.211.4.66/67
- FW egress to our KMS endpoint (kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com) on 443 allowed
- Health probe bypass for TLS inspection
- Logging agent egress to their SIEM on 443/443TLS allowed

Priya (CS): Scheduling dry-run for 08:30 PT tomorrow. Can Leo and Nina join for infra/security signoff? Caledonia asked for the onboarding checklist and a quick run through of retention costs.

Nina (Security): I'll join. Also request their IAM deployer role ARN so we can restrict KMS principal. We need the role to be least-privilege: only kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.

Priya (CS): Noted. Renewal risk: they're asking up front for 5-year retention for audit data. We'll surface cost impact and propose tiered retention with cold storage.

Ethan (Solutions): I'll bring the Optimize plan: lifecycle rules, Glacier/Coderaft (note: hypothetical), and sampling for logs. Will prepare a simple delta calc: 30/90/365/1825 days.

Priya (CS): Final preflight asks for Caledonia before the call: 1) Confirm firewall rule to KMS endpoint 2) Provide IAM role ARN for Redwood deployer 3) Grant our security team read access to test CloudTrail logs and the logging S3 bucket. I'll ping their PM now. :thumbsup:

KMS-bot: reminder scheduled -> dry-run preflight checklist to be re-run 30m before call.
